additional_info.subject: RE: ID0421988-DC/Si-D/NZ-[Y2 / R3 313057296006]Issues with a Volvo Loader CRM:02681000133
additional_info.body:
Hello Liz Hatton,
Please discard the previous email & attached logs which were shared, Apologies for sharing logs from different charger.
As checked no logs are available on SCB for the month of April except limited logs on 8th April,25.
We will escalated the issue of no logs available in SCB but charger is online , we will reply you back.
Meanwhile we have checked the charger remotely & below are the observations.
1) In Outlet 1
On 290425 at 18:04 UTC
EVCCID:9cf6dd9247fb
Session stopped in charge parameter discovery stage
Reason: wrong parameter shared by EV
DC_EVSEMinimumVoltageLimit=0 DC_EVSEMaximumVoltageLimit=0 DC_EVSEMaximumPowerLimit=0 EVSEProcessing=Finished
2)
In Outlet 1
On 290425 at 18:04 UTC
EVCCID:9cf6dd9247fb
Charging session was successful form 91% SOC to 100% SOC
3)
In Outlet 1
On 290425 at 18:04 UTC
EVCCID:9cf6dd9247fb
Session stopped in charge parameter discovery stage
Reason: wrong parameter shared by EV
DC_EVSEMinimumVoltageLimit=0 DC_EVSEMaximumVoltageLimit=0 DC_EVSEMaximumPowerLimit=0 EVSEProcessing=Finished
4)
No session on DC2 since Feb 2025 (May be sessions are performed by due to date time issue logs are not captured correctly.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sunil Sharma
